results.rationale: Consistency: The white backdrop remains, but both turtles have different shell contours and scute patterns, faces and leg poses; the unrequested small turtle is reduced and separated from its neighbor. Most major subject details are changed beyond resizing the large turtle. Instruction: The edit still shows a much larger left turtle and a much smaller right turtle. The expected result is the original large turtle reduced to the small turtle’s size; the conspicuous size disparity remains, so the requested match is not achieved. Quality, edited image alone: Structure, naturalness, artifact absence and texture fidelity are satisfactory; both animals have coherent shells, heads and scaled legs, with plausible soft contact shadows and clean white surroundings.

These are multiple noticeable changes outside the allowed left-clock resizing. Instruction: The left clock has been enlarged from smaller than the right clock to approximately its size.
